chunks: And whatever is in it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Miqdām, I have narrated it from Aḥmad ibn Ziyād ibn Jaʿfar al-Hamadānī — may Allah be pleased with him — from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Miqdām.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: may Allah be pleased with him
key_terms.عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي ا: from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Miqdām
key_terms.فِي ه: in it; referring to the book/text

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Miqdām in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Miqdām. It serves as a transmission-chain notice in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, identifying the intermediaries between the compiler and that narrator.
